summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal developments, including Supreme Court rulings and a contempt case, alongside key retail sector updates.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court initiates contempt proceedings after a litigant attempted to throw a purse at a judge.
Supreme Court directs the Law Commission to propose reforms for the expedited execution of arbitral awards.
A plea before the Supreme Court contests the exclusion of charitable activities from the definition of 'industry' under the IR Code.
Reliance Consumer expands its FMCG portfolio with the launch of Joyland Dairy Drinks.
Meesho's Q2 FY27 net loss narrows to Rs 132.45 crore, while revenue rises 34.4% to Rs 4,131.58 crore.
